title: Dark Green Account Referral Program
summary: Dark Green Account Referral Program: you earn a $40 referral bonus for each qualifying referral; the referred person gets a $30 welcome bonus. Referrals are capped at 6 referral bonuses per year, requiring 45 days as a Rho-Bank checking customer and at least a $1,000 deposit within 60 days of the new account opening.
faqs: How much is the referral bonus for the person referring and for the person joining?
What is the maximum number of referral bonuses I can earn per year?
What requirements must I meet (e.g., the 45-day minimum) to qualify for my $40 bonus?
What does the referred person need to do to qualify (open Dark Green Account and deposit at least $1,000 within 60 days)?
